classifications.rationale: The President determines that Gabon and Mongolia should later be designated; this segment does not itself confer beneficiary status or direct an agency to do so.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that Gabon and Mongolia should be designated as beneficiary developing countries for purposes of the GSP.

classifications.rationale: The President determines that two country names should later be modified, without this segment itself modifying the tariff schedule or legal status.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the names of two previously designated beneficiary developing countries should be modified.

classifications.rationale: The President determines that Mauritania's suspension should later end; the segment does not itself terminate the suspension or restore preferential treatment.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the suspension pursuant to Proclamation 6575 of June 25, 1993, of preferential treatment for Mauritania as a least-developed beneficiary developing country under the GSP should be ended.

classifications.rationale: The President determines the tariff-treatment result that should be implemented later, but neither presently withdraws treatment nor commands an agency to do so in this segment.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that certain beneficiary developing countries should not receive preferential tariff treatment under the GSP

classifications.rationale: The President determines that specified countries should later be redesignated for certain articles; this segment does not itself effect the redesignations.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that certain countries should be redesignated as beneficiary developing countries with respect to certain eligible articles

classifications.rationale: The President determines that a competitive-need limitation should later be waived; the segment does not itself declare that the waiver applies.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the competitive need limitation provided in section 503(c)(2)(A)(i)(II) should be waived

classifications.rationale: The President determines that competitive-need limitations should later be waived, without this segment itself applying the waivers.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the competitive need limitations of section 503(c)(2)(A) of the 1974 Act should be waived

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutorily relevant national-economic-interest determination supporting the waivers; that legal finding occurs in this segment.
classifications.evidence: I have determined, based on that advice and on the considerations described in sections 501 and 502(c) of the 1974 Act, that such waivers are in the national economic interest of the United States.

classifications.rationale: The President determines that Cambodia should later be added to the HTS list; this segment does not itself amend the HTS or confer the resulting treatment.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that Cambodia should be added to the list of countries identified in general note 4(a) of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTS)

classifications.rationale: The President directly modifies the HTS, applies a statutory waiver, supersedes inconsistent prior provisions, and specifies effective dates; those legal consequences arise from the segment itself.
classifications.evidence: A waiver of the application of section 503(c)(2)(A) of the 1974 Act shall apply to the eligible articles in the HTS subheadings and to the beneficiary developing countries set forth in Annex II to this proclamation.
